title: Asymptotics for two-dimensional parabolic vectorial Allen-Cahn systems
summary: We study the parabolic vectorial Allen--Cahn equation in two space dimensions for a fixed smooth potential with finitely many non-degenerate wells. Our result provides a parabolic extension of Bethuel's elliptic compactness theorem: at almost every positive time, the diffuse energy, potential energy, and gradient tensor converge to measures concentrated on a countably \(1\)-rectifiable interface and satisfy all the Bethuel-type relations.
